title: Book Two · Chapter 35: Sunday Plans
story:
Mum wears the blue skirt on Sunday morning.

Her keys make a little sound in the pocket. She puts a clean hand towel in her bag and looks towards the door.

Dad is sitting beside the old box. Ronan is on the floor with his picture book.

“You will eat without me at noon,” Mum says. “There is rice in the kitchen.”

“Can we eat all of it?” Ronan asks.

“Please leave the pot.”

Dad laughs. Mum leaves through the green gate.

For a while, Dad turns the drawer in his hands. He puts it into the box, then takes it out. He draws a short line beside one old mark.

Ronan looks over.

“Can I pull the handle?”

“Not while I am checking the side. Later.”

Ronan goes back to his book. The boy in today's picture is sitting on a step. Ronan reads one line, then looks at Dad again.

“You said we might walk.”

Dad puts the drawer down.

“We did say that. We can go after lunch. I need to leave this alone for a while.”

Ronan checks the sky. There are only small clouds.

He helps lay the table. Dad takes two bowls from the kitchen. The black cat waits outside the door.

“No bowl for you,” Dad tells it.

The cat lies across the warm step anyway.

After lunch, they wash the bowls and go out. Dad closes the room door. The box stays inside, clear of the window.

They walk beside the river. A man is pushing a long pole into the water. His boat turns slowly. Ronan stops to watch.

“Can we do that?”

“Not today. I do not know that boat.”

They sit on a low wall instead. Dad gives him half a piece of bread. A small bird comes close, then hops away again.

Ronan takes a little crumb on one finger. The bird keeps its distance.

“It is waiting for you to go,” Dad says.

Ronan puts the crumb on the wall and moves back. The bird comes closer.

They wait quietly. At last it takes the bread.

On the way home, Dad asks about Tuesday.

“Do you want to read something with me?”

“We can look at one page.”

They choose a short page from Ronan's own book. Dad reads a line. Ronan reads the next. Once, both start together and stop at the same word.

“Your turn,” Dad says.

“No, yours.”

They begin together again. Ronan laughs and covers his mouth with his hand.

Dad puts a finger beside the next line.

“This one is mine.”

Ronan puts his finger beside the line below it. Dad reads. Ronan waits until Dad moves his hand away. Then he begins.

They reach the bottom without speaking together again. Ronan points to the empty space below the last line.

“That one is for the cat.”

Mum returns while they are putting the book away. She tells them about her friend's new kitchen shelf. Ronan asks about the skirt.

“It came with me and came home again,” she says. “Very useful.”

Dad opens the door for her. There is a little mud on one shoe. She takes it off before she comes inside.

Ronan puts the reading book beside his school bag. Dad covers the wooden box. The three of them sit down together for dinner.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

pole＝长杆；crumb＝面包屑；hop＝单脚跳、小鸟跳；distance＝距离。

## 理解问题

1. Dad怎样安排木盒检查与散步？
2. 父子读书时发生了什么轻松的小插曲？

## 读句子

The bird / keeps / its distance.＝那只鸟／保持／距离。
